title: Nine Words from Nowhere
subtitle: 航天探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 航天探索（宇宙探索·太空与航天）
meta: 主题语境：航天探索（宇宙探索·太空与航天）　|　核心词汇：astronaut　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 astronaut 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 an ① astronaut said nine words from a place nobody had stood, and my grandfather refused to watch it. The ② astronaut, meaning the man and not the machine, was thirty-nine and had trained for four years; an astronaut, my grandmother said, is somebody who has agreed to be the last person to see the earth. She said the refusing was my grandfather's way of agreeing.

Every ③ astronaut in those years was a pilot first, and she said that was not an accident. Their ④ astronaut — the one my brother wrote to in 1971 — sent a printed card and nothing else; an astronaut, my father said, is the only person whose job is to leave and whose duty is to come back. He said the card arrived in March.

My brother wanted to be ⑤ an astronaut for nine years and then wanted to be a bus driver, which he said was the same thing with more people. The ⑥ astronaut, meaning the profession and not the man, is nine parts waiting and one part leaving; an astronaut, my mother said, is the only worker who is trained mostly for the part that does not happen. She said the training was four years and the leaving was nine minutes.

By 1975 the ⑦ astronaut had given nine talks and said the same nine sentences in each. The ⑧ astronaut on the poster in my brother's room was not the same man at all; an astronaut, my father said, is a person who is famous for a thing that only nine people have done. He said the poster was bought for eleven pence.

The ⑨ astronaut I remember is the one in the photograph, standing next to a machine he did not build. An ⑩ astronaut, my grandfather said in 1979, is the only traveller whose luggage is entirely other people's work; every astronaut, he said, is a passenger who has been taught to call himself a pilot. He said he had been a passenger himself once and knew.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 宇航员；航天员（一个人）
B. n. 宇航员（指人本身，与机器相对）
C. n. 宇航员（指照片里的那一位）
D. n. 宇航员（指海报上的那一位）
E. n. 宇航员（指这个职业、这门行当）
F. n. 宇航员（泛指这类人）
G. n. 宇航员（抽象总称）
H. n. 宇航员（指弟弟写信的那一位）

items.q: The astronaut, meaning the man and not the machine
the astronaut had given nine talks
An astronaut, my grandfather said in 1979

answers.why: astronaut 意为“宇航员、航天员”，1969 年有一位宇航员在一个从未有人站立过的地方说了九个字。
astronaut 指“人本身”，与机器相对，那位宇航员三十九岁，训练了四年。
astronaut 泛指“宇航员这类人”，那几年里每一位宇航员首先都是飞行员，她说那不是偶然。
astronaut 指弟弟写信的那一位，他们那位宇航员，也就是 1971 年弟弟写信去的那位，只寄回一张印刷卡片。
astronaut 意为“宇航员”，弟弟有九年想当宇航员，后来想当巴士司机，他说那是一回事，只是人更多。
astronaut 指“这个职业、这门行当”，与人相对，是九分等待加一分出发。
astronaut 意为“宇航员”，到 1975 年那位宇航员做过九场演讲，每场说的都是同样的九句话。
astronaut 指海报上的那一位，弟弟房间里海报上的那位宇航员根本不是同一个人。
astronaut 指照片里的那一位，我记得的是照片上那位，站在一台不是他造的机器旁边。
astronaut 为抽象总称，祖父说宇航员是唯一行李全是别人劳动的旅行者。
